Package index

Fit, tune and compare sparse models

L0glm.fit()
Fit generalized linear model with \(L_0\) or grouped row-\(L_0\) regularization subject to optional nonnegativity constraints
L0glm.tune()
Tunes the regularisation parameter lambda of an L0glm fit
L0nnpois()
Fast nonnegative identity-link Poisson L0 or grouped L0 penalized fit
sparseglm() coef(<sparseglm>) plot(<sparseglm>)
Fit, tune and compare sparse regression methods
L0glm.metrics()
Essential fit and recovery metrics for an L0glm model
preclustering
Preclustering response channels before sparse Poisson fitting
compulsory_terms
Nonnegative compulsory terms and smooth backgrounds

Predictions, summaries and information criteria

predict(<L0glm_fit>) predict(<L0glm_extended_fit>) predict(<sparseglm>) fitted(<L0glm_fit>) fitted(<sparseglm>)

Print and summarize sparse regression fits
logLik(<L0glm_fit>) nobs(<L0glm_fit>) coef(<L0glm_fit>) GIC() EBIC() MBIC()
Likelihood, information criteria and coefficients of an L0glm fit
information_criteria
Information-criterion presets for sparse GLMs
preset.lambda()
Calculate an information-criterion penalty preset

Screening, simulations and solvers

sis_glm()
Efficient-score screening for GLMs and special families
simul()
Simulate sparse GLMs and deconvolution problems
simulate_spike_train()
Simulate a blurred single or multichannel spike train
simulate_GCMS()
Simulate synthetic GC-MS chromatograms with ground-truth signal + background
lmridge()
Fits a ridge regularised weighted least squares regression using a chosen solver subject to optional nonnegativity or box constraints on the coefficients.
control.solver.gen()
Set Options of Constrained Ridge Regularised Weighted Least Squares Regression Solvers

L0glm_blind_deco()
Alternating sparse L0 glm powered blind deconvolution
L0glm_deco_estkernel()
Estimate the PSF given a spike train estimate via L0-penalised GLMs
spoloconmf() print(<spoloconmf>) fitted(<spoloconmf>)

convmatrix()

Generate normalised 1-D convolution kernels (point-spread functions)
estimate_psf_from_std()
Estimate a time-varying PSF matrix from an alkane ladder TIC
log_conc_smooth()
Log-concave spline smoothing of a discrete convolution kernel estimate
